description: Canonical small-file layout for an individual Spark node.
rules: The Git checkout contains code and configuration only.
Full model archives do not belong on internal root storage.
Rank-local payloads are flat files plus a manifest; topology and encoding belong in the dataset name or manifest.
A complete source model belongs on extnvme or cold storage; srcdata on a node is only a local build input.
Legacy paths are reported until their contents are migrated and verified; audit never deletes them.
